full_prompt:
Draw exactly ONE Small Seal glyph U+3D060.
The supplied chart shows FOUR historical views of the SAME ONE Small Seal character, ordered THX, CCZ, QJZ, DYC. Compare EVERY available witness equally; any slot marked unavailable provides no evidence. Create ONE newly drawn, coherent contemporary sans-serif/Gothic glyph informed by all witnesses, selecting ONE coherent attested construction where variants differ. Never combine incompatible components or replace this with modern Chinese. Trace the real continuous writing-stroke courses using smooth rounded curves and appropriate straight segments; preserve all meaningful branches, legs, bars, counters, crossings, attachments and detachments. Each intentional stroke has the SAME CONSTANT width, approximately 3% of the full canvas, with rounded caps and joins. No brush taper, thick/thin pressure, serifs, texture, ink blobs, doubled outlines or ornamental seal effects. Output exactly ONE complete glyph, black on transparent alpha, centered within the central70% of a square canvas with generous clear margins. No reference copies, four-character layout, labels, text, frames, grid, backdrop or shadows.
PRECISE CHARACTER READING, after comparing all four references:
1. Left ritual component: detached short upper bar above a longer lower bar; central long descender attached to lower bar, with two detached side descenders.
2. Upper-right ring has a short flag stem rising from its top with a right-facing flag branch; enclosed two crossing diagonals form X plus FOUR small inward marks, one inside each triangular field (short horizontal at top/bottom and short vertical at left/right in THX). Do not omit those four salt-like marks.
3. Middle-right rounded oval/rectangle is separate from the upper ring, narrower than it, divided by one horizontal into TWO counters in coherent THX/CCZ form.
4. Below is ONE small separate oval with one counter, nested inside an open upward U-shaped cup; cup's center vertical tail descends below its bottom. Cup arms and small oval remain separated.
Use coherent thin monoline THX/CCZ-type component connections after weighing QJZ/DYC equally. Preserve the tiny four inward marks in the upper X ring as intentional strokes; never simplify that ring to a bare X. Keep the middle two-counter oval, lower small one-counter oval and open cup all distinct.
